evidence: Returns zero immediately when the entry count in the second argument is zero. Otherwise it obtains the table pointer, skips when the table is absent or disabled, invokes status helpers, and calls the established build_sorted_record_table helper to process the enabled table. The name captures the guarded table-build path without assigning the record type. decompiled/main/main_0089.c:23132-23178; build_sorted_record_table body decompiled/main/main_0089.c:24070-24112.

Scans the global rule-entry table for an entry whose first 16-bit key matches the input selector; if found, iterates its nested 16-byte rules and calls apply_attribute_record_rule for each. The indexed caller invokes this during a broader record-processing path after checking a count/selector range. The table domain is not established, so the label stays at the visible rule application. decompiled/main/main_0050.c:15835-15880; helper decompiled/main/main_0050.c:15882-16256; indexed caller decompiled/main/main_0165.c:40620-40634.

If the SSL context flag at +0x794 is set, reserves two bytes for packet entry 0x31 through reserve_ssl_packet_buffer_space, runs two validation/update helpers, and sets the context flag at +0x790 only when the checks succeed; otherwise it reports an OpenSSL client-extension error. The exact extension semantics are left unspecified. decompiled/main/main_0157.c:12641-12683; reserve helper decompiled/main/main_0156.c:35507-35615; behavior-index string evidence identifies openssl/ssl/statem/extensions_clnt.c.

Initializes the caller output to UINT32_MAX, then queries attribute-context selector 0x13 and follows status-dependent branches. Some paths query the derived context value and write a byte-like check result to the caller output; other statuses leave the sentinel unchanged. No indexed caller establishes the domain meaning of the result. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:1708-1753; attribute_context_status_value_get implementation decompiled/main/main_0093.c:48967-49067.

Uses helper checks to decide whether to invoke the established serialize_optional_rtts_goal_completion_record routine; on the successful path it then loads and dispatches a callback from the input object at +0x58. The serializer is conditional and the record type is not inferred from this wrapper. decompiled/main/main_0036.c:5123-5163; serialize helper decompiled/main/main_0032.c:8601-8638.
